verdicts.note: 'I oppose any tax increases' and a call for 'lower taxes' (S1) are explicit and absolute; -2 fits. High holds: two separate statements, and his pay-opinion remark about safeguarding 'taxpayers and their hard-earned money' (S4) points the same way. The ESSB 6346 single-vote rule does not apply (no legislative vote).

Attacked on magnitude: 'a government that lives within its means' and 'smart, limited government' (S1), ending the Benton County human services agreement over cost (S3), and seeking the AG opinion on past commissioners' pay (S4) are a stated position plus two acts in office, all toward restraint and accountability. The human services exit shifted some services to the state rather than cutting them (S3), but the stated rationale was cost. -2 high stands.
Sitting commissioner and 2025 chairman running on his record (S1, S2, S3). The dossier does not give his length of tenure, so -1 rather than -2 is the right restraint.
No elected record; volunteer planning commissioner challenging a sitting commissioner (S1). 1 at medium fits: some county-government exposure, no explicit renewal theme.
